resources.string: Your vault is encrypted on-device with Argon2id and AES-256-GCM before anything ever leaves your phone. We never see your secrets.
Elvarix integrates deeply with Android\'s autofill framework to securely fill credentials in any application or web browser.
Unlock your vault in milliseconds with fingerprint or face recognition, guarded by Android Keystore hardware protection.

Your Master Password is known only to you. It cannot be recovered by Elvarix or anyone else. Losing it means permanent loss of your vault unless you have a Recovery Kit.
Save your Recovery Kit somewhere safe and offline. It is the only way to regain access to your vault if you forget your Master Password. Elvarix has no backdoor.
